about: ValueInput at start and after a factory reset (types/0x0011-value-input.md §5.6; zadania/devices/DEVICE-02.md S1): a stored Value comes back; one outside the stored range is clipped to it; FactoryReset erases Value and the range — a new boot starts at MinValue — but not ChangeCount, which counts wear, as PressCount does.

steps.note: at MinValue a step down is nothing
settings gone, the counter stays; without a restart the node rejoins (factory_reset.json)
